{{External|rs}}{{HasStrategy|page=Chompy bird hunting/Strategy}}{{Redirect|Chompy}} {{Switch infobox |text1=Alive |item1= {{Infobox Monster |name = Chompy bird |image = [[File:Chompy bird.png|250px]] |release = [[18 May]] [[2004]] |update = Big Chompy Bird Hunting |members = Yes |combat = 6 |size = 1 |examine = A large boisterous bird, a delicacy for ogres. |xpbonus = |max hit = 0 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = None |attack speed = No |slayxp = 10 |cat = Birds |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 10 |att = 5 |str = 5 |def = 3 |mage = 0 |range = 0 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |id = 1475 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} |text2=Dead |item2= {{Infobox NPC |name = Chompy bird |image = [[File:Chompy bird (downed).png|250px]] |release = [[18 May]] [[2004]] |update = Big Chompy Bird Hunting |members = Yes |race = [[Bird (disambiguation)|Bird]] |quest = [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] |location = [[Feldip Hills]] |options = Pluck |examine = A once boisterous bird, closer to being an ogre delicacy. |map = No |id = 1476 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} }} [[File:Chompy bird escapes.png|thumb|left|An escaping chompy bird]] '''Chompy birds''' are part of the [[chompy bird hunting]] activity. They can only be killed after completing the [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] [[quest]]. Killing them requires a [[comp ogre bow]] or [[ogre bow]] with [[brutal arrows]] or [[ogre arrows]]. They '''cannot''' be killed with [[melee]] or [[Magic]]. Thralls will also not attack them. [[Bloated toad]]s must be used as bait to lure them to the area. Bloated toads are made by using [[ogre bellows]] filled with swamp gas on nearby toads at the swamp. Chompy birds spawn in a 10 tile radius around the bloated toad (21x21 square). A chompy bird will leave if it is not killed after one minute. Killing a chompy bird yields the message: ''"You scratch a notch on your bow for the chompy bird kill."'' Each kill yields a chompy bird corpse which can be plucked for [[feather]]s, a [[raw chompy]], [[bones]] and grants 30 [[Hunter]] experience, while it will disappear after two minutes if left untouched.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1564645716034830336|date=30 August 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107192|archivedate=4 March 2023|quote=[Hello, once a chompy bird has been killed, how long will the corpse lay on the ground for before it despawns? (...)] 2 mins, I think. (...)}} The [[bonecrusher]]'s effect works on the bones when plucking the dead chompy. After 30 kills, players can claim their first [[chompy bird hat]]. The bird [[Slayer task]] assigned by [[Turael]] and [[Spria]] can be completed with chompy birds; while they are much slower kills than chickens, it can be sped up with gear listed on [[chompy bird hunting]]. Completing tiers of the [[Western Provinces Diary]] will grant benefits when killing chompy birds: *Completing the [[Easy Western Provinces|easy]] Western Province tasks will grant a 25% chance of two chompy birds appearing. *Completing the [[Medium Western Provinces|medium]] Western Province tasks will grant a 50% chance of two chompy birds appearing. *Completing the [[Elite Western Provinces|elite]] Western Province tasks will grant a 100% chance of two chompy birds appearing. ==Spawn mechanics== {{Main|Bloated toad#Spawn mechanics}} Each bloated toad has a 1 in 5 chance to attract a chompy bird every 25 ticks (15 seconds) from the moment it is placed on the ground. Up to four rolls can be made by a bloated toad before it bursts, although no further rolls are made after a toad has successfully called down a chompy. ==Hunter info== {{Hunter info |name = Chompy bird |level = 1 |xp = 30 |trap = No |bait = Bloated toad |retaliation = No }} ==Strategy== {{Main|Chompy bird hunting/Strategy}} ==Locations== {|class="wikitable" ![[Feldip Hills]] ![[Chompy Marsh]] |- |[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|aks}} |[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bkp}} |- |{{Map|name=Chompy bird|x=2598|y=2966|r=5|mtype=square}} |{{Map|name=Chompy bird|2322,3077|2372,3077|2382,3067|2434,3067|2434,3029|2322,3029|mtype=polygon}} |} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Raw chompy|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Feather|quantity=10-30|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Other=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Chompy chick|quantity=1|rarity=1/500|raritynotes=Only players who have completed the elite [[Western Provinces Diary]] are eligible to receive this pet.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/627910212083691520|date=2 August 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99168|archivedate=26 May 2020|notes=(As a reaction to the archived tweet)|quote=(Are they both 1/500?)
